name: Suds and Buds
summary: Suds and Buds is a short visual novel in which you play as the lovely Protagonist, who makes a late-night trip to the laundromat after finding their washing machine broken. However, in a world where vampires roam free, crazy scientists experiment on the undead, and other creatures wander with pride. . . our Protagonist is nothing but a fast-food employee. Isn't that embarrassing?!?!? Choose a peculiar stranger to talk to and mix your laundry loads with, spin the conversation in your favor, and get that washing machine spinning to win a lifetime friend!
